text: Artificial Intelligence, or AI, is the ability of machines to do tasks that normally require human intelligence. These tasks include learning, problem-solving, and understanding language. Machine learning is a part of AI. It allows computers to learn from data and improve without being told exactly what to do. Deep learning is a more advanced form of machine learning that uses large neural networks to handle complex tasks, such as recognising images or speech. Today, AI is everywhere in daily life. We use it in voice assistants, search engines, social media, online shopping, and even in cars. AI makes our lives easier and faster.
